title: kpipho/varcall pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input. Each row describes one paired-end Illumina sequencing run plus the sample metadata needed to track it through the pipeline.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 (forward/R1) must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 (reverse/R2) must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'. This pipeline only supports paired-end data.

run_date.errorMessage: Date the sample was sequenced/run, in ISO-8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

sample_type.errorMessage: Sample type must be provided and cannot contain spaces, e.g. 'tumor', 'normal', 'control'
